parsed.rationale: All three `CodingKeys` enums — `Announcement.CodingKeys`, `Breakpoint.CodingKeys`, and `Talkset.CodingKeys` — are nested types required by Swift's `Codable` synthesis machinery. Each must be declared as a private nested enum inside its own parent type to control which keys participate in encoding/decoding for that specific type. Although the structural pipeline reports `shared_field_count: 4` and flags them as exact duplicates, their identical shape is a coincidence of the domain model (all three types happen to encode the same number of fields) rather than a sign of extractable logic. Merging or aliasing them would break `Codable` conformance, since each `CodingKeys` enum is bound by name to its enclosing type. No restraint markers are present, but the structural coincidence is load-bearing and intentional.
